The PvP medallions (often called the "CC break trinkets") are a specific kind of PvP trinket that removes all movement impairing effects and effects that cause the loss of control of the character during PvP. Only one of these trinkets can be equipped as they also use a unique-equipped for "Gladiator's Medallions". It is meant to be equipped alongside a PvP emblem, providing the set bonus from the Gladiator's Distinction.

Puzzling Cartel Chips are awarded from weekly quests that task players with either defeating four bosses in the current seasonal raid or completing four Mythic+ dungeons during Turbo Boost events. Nine total chips are available per character, enough for three purchases. Trade three chips with a vendor near the Great Vault in Dornogal for selected Hero or Myth track items from the raid or dungeon trinkets. Hero-track items have no requirements beyond the currency cost. For Myth track raid items, players must defeat the boss that drops the item on Mythic difficulty in order to purchase the Mythic version of the item. The PvP emblems are a selection of PvP trinkets that provide a specific benefit in PvP combat, depending on the type. Only one of these trinkets can be equipped as they also use a unique-equipped for "Gladiator's Emblems". It is meant to be equipped alongside a PvP medallion that helps with movement impairing effects, providing the set bonus from the Gladiator's Distinction. Unlike the PvP medallion being replaced with PvP talents, the emblems continued through but did not have the set bonus.

It came back once again as part of the 21st Anniversary celebration, running from 13 August to 11 September 2026. Quill-bears, or pangquills, are large beasts that somewhat resemble bears or pangolins—with similar heavy, knucklewalking builds, long tails, and long claws—but with bat-like head features and bodies covered in fur and quills rather than scales. They were among the fiercest predators in the primordial fauna of Mount Hyjal. The ancient haranir druids adopted their appearance for their bear form, allowing the haranir to rival and eventually tame the animals. Very few descendants of the original Hyjal quill-bears still exist. The few that do, such as Nahuut, live in Harandar alongside the Hara'ti, who honor the beasts. __NOTOC__

The Radiant Echoes is the pre- launch event running from 30 July 2024 to 26 August. The event was available to level 10-70 characters. After Magni Bronzebeard attempted to commune with Azeroth to make sense of the Radiant Song, memories of old characters and past events came to life once more. The event has invasions in three separate locations, split between Kalimdor, the Eastern Kingdoms, and Northrend - Dustwallow Marsh, Searing Gorge, and the Dragonblight. Broken Isles Dalaran serves as the hub for the event. The active zone is denoted by an icon: : Azeroth's memories are bubbling up in !

The Ragged Front is a battleground between Azj-Kahet and southeastern Hallowfall. Hemmed in by the Aegis Wall until it was breached by Dreadstrike nerubians, many Arathi have fallen here and their corpses need to be burned so they're not raised. The area is bordered by the Aegis Wall to the northwest, and the Sanguine Grasps (and Skittering Breach delve!) to the west. A nerubian tunnel to Arathi's End in Azj-Kahet is at downhill to the east.

Raen Dawncavalyr is the head armorer of the Hallowfall Arathi, located in the armory in Mereldar in Hallowfall. At times, she can also appear in the Sinkhole delve. During the later stages of the war against Queen Ansurek and Azj-Kahet, Dawncavalyr joined the Flame's Radiance at Morgaen's Tears. There she served in similar duties to those in Mereldar, namely selling wares to adventurers seeking fortune and glory.

__NOTOC__ Radiant Echo is found in a Bountiful Coffer at the end of a bountiful delve, after being opened with a Restored Coffer Key. Take echoes to the active Worldsoul Memories event in zones to begin.

Rage-Filled Idol is a curio for Brann Bronzebeard during The War Within Season 1. The baseline version is found in low-tier delves, and higher-rank versions are found in higher-tier delves, all the way up to the Rank 4 version in Tier 8 delves.

Radiant Girdle of the Dawn are upgraded from Girdle of the Dawn#Classic at any Argent Dawn quartermaster. The upgrade costs 2 Corruptor's Scourgestone and 2 Frayed Abomination Stitching and requires with the Argent Dawn.

The Rage Talon Quartermaster can be found patrolling between Halycon's Lair and the Storehouse in Lower Blackrock Spire. It only appears when entering the dungeon without being in a party.

Rage Statue is an ogre statue located at the bottom of the entrance stairs in Karazhan Catacombs during the Ratts' Revenge scenario. If interacted with, it can be dragged around and repositioned, which is required for the 8 o'clock puzzle for the Keys to Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle.

Radiant Citrine is a crystal located in the central chamber of the Forgotten Vault on the Siren Isle. Picking it up grants the character the Glittering Vault Shard buff, transforming them to an iron vrykul. Head to the right chamber and interact with the Stone Carver's Scramseax.

Racial mounts are ground mounts associated with the playable races. Core race mounts can be purchased from vendors. Allied race mounts are given as a reward for unlocking the relevant race—usually from the final quest in the unlock questline. The Argent Tournament mounts and some PvP mounts are modeled after the core racial mounts. Additionally, paladins receive their own mounts based on race.
